# JPEG test data

These fixtures are copied unchanged from the Go 1.23.0 source distribution at
`src/image/testdata` in the `go1.23.0` tag:
https://go.googlesource.com/go/+/refs/tags/go1.23.0/src/image/testdata/

The JPEG tests in `../jpeg` are derived from Go's `image/jpeg` package
tests. The binary fixtures are distributed under the Go Authors' BSD-style
license; see [GO-LICENSE.txt](GO-LICENSE.txt), copied from the same Go 1.23.0
source distribution. Fixture SHA-256 checksums are recorded below to make the
provenance reproducible.
